candidates.claim: DMZ_IN entry fw-01:68 permits the historian 10.10.20.10 to reach OT 10.10.10.0/24 on tcp/102, and it is effective because DMZ_IN is bound inbound on the dmz interface at fw-01:102; this path is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1-A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the DMZ_IN entry at fw-01:68 so historian-to-OT traffic is denied, unless an approved change record authorizes it.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits any source to tcp/443 on 203.0.113.2, the fw-01 outside interface, while fw-01 has the ASA HTTP server enabled, so HTTPS management is not restricted to MGMT as the management policy requires.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit at rtr-01:68 for tcp/443 to 203.0.113.2 and disable the fw-01 HTTP server, or confirm that HTTPS management is limited to MGMT on the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The DMZ_IN access-list line at fw-01:68 was added relative to the approved baseline and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile fw-01:68 against the approved baseline and revert it unless an approved change record covers it.

clarifications.question: The registry says IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers must be disabled, but fw-01 is an ASA with asa_http_server enabled. Should the ASA HTTP server be disabled, or is it acceptable because mgmt_access limits it to 10.10.99.0/24 on the mgmt interface?
